title: Purpose Manifest
description: The machine-readable map of what every PART of Project Holocron is FOR. One record per part (a shared core, a feature module, an app surface, a backend, a data registry, a pipeline, a verification family, an infra file, a document family). Consumed by agents at boot to answer 'what is X for, who loads it, what verifies it' without reading the code. Kept honest by test/purpose_manifest.cjs, which fails when a covered tree gains a file no part claims or a part names a path that no longer exists. Human narrative lives in Docs/PURPOSE_AUDIT.md; this file carries facts only.

measured_at.description: The commit every path, count and claim was read at (instrument norm 1: a citation carries the commit it was read at).

coverage_roots.description: Directory prefixes (and exact files) in which EVERY tracked file must be claimed by some part's `paths`. The guard enumerates these; anything unclaimed is a red. Trees outside these roots (Docs/gates, Docs/rulings, scripts/smoke_*, …) are covered by a FAMILY part instead and are not enumerated file-by-file.

layers.description: The architectural layers, top to bottom, each with a one-sentence purpose. A part belongs to exactly one.

slug.description: Dotted id; segments may be camelCase to mirror a file name (shared.charResolve).

path.description: Repo-relative. A trailing slash claims a whole directory; a trailing `*` claims every tracked file with that prefix (a family, e.g. scripts/smoke_*); otherwise an exact file.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. `shared.charResolve`, `app.player`, `data.registry.species`. Rename only when the concept changes.

purpose.description: Plain language, one to three sentences: what the part is FOR (the job it does for the product), not what it contains.

kind.description: Where the purpose is DEFINED. `inferred` means no file or doc states it and this manifest is the first place it is written down — a finding, not a fact.

ref.description: path[:line] or path#section of the defining text.

publishes.description: Globals (window.SWRPG*), routes (/api/v1/sync), or files the part produces.

loaded_by.description: Which runtime hosts execute it. `none` is a finding (dead or build-input only).

depends_on.description: Other part ids this part reads at runtime or build time.

map.description: The living document that maps this part's internals in more detail (NAVIGATION.md, CREATOR_MAP.md, SHEET_PLUMBING.md, …).

status.description: sound = purpose defined and the code does that job. stale-doc = the defining text contradicts the code. undefined = no defining text existed before this manifest. dead = loaded by nothing. duplicated = a second implementation of the same job exists. dark = built and shipped but behind an OFF switch.

findings.description: Audit findings, one sentence each, each pointing at a path or symbol. Empty when status is `sound`.

sections.description: For monoliths: named line ranges so an agent can navigate without reading the file. Lines rot; every section carries the commit it was measured at via the manifest's `measured_at`.
